metadata.title: On polarizations of affine Calabi--Yau varieties
metadata.abstract: Let $(X, \Omega)$ be an affine Calabi--Yau variety, by which we mean a klt affine variety $X$ with a non-vanishing algebraic volume form $\Omega$. In connection with complete Calabi--Yau metrics of Euclidean volume growth on $(X, \Omega)$, we study algebraic aspects of polarizations of $X$ given by a negative valuation. We show that such a valuation is finitely generated with a klt degeneration if and only if $X$ admits a dlt log Fano type compactification, generalizing a compactification considered by Tian--Yau. We further give a valuative criterion detecting K-semistability of the degeneration by a negative valuation.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究仿射 Calabi–Yau 簇由负赋值给出的极化，以及有限生成退化与紧化的关系。
techniques: klt 退化和 dlt log Fano 紧化
analysis.breakthrough: 证明具有 klt 退化的有限生成赋值与指定 dlt log Fano 型紧化等价，并给出检测退化 K-半稳定性的赋值条件。
analysis.limitations: 核心结果是代数刻画；与欧氏体积增长完全 Calabi–Yau 度量的联系，不等于已对所有这些极化构造相应完备度量。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 连接无穷远代数数据、退化和完整几何问题。
